record.name: Nina Mamužić
record.title: Professor Emeritus
record.department: Department of Fruit Growing, Viticulture, Horticulture and Landscape Architecture
record.bio: Nina Mamužić received her BSc and MSc degrees from the Faculty of Agriculture, University of Novi Sad, and completed her PhD there in 1993 with a dissertation on flavonoid profiles in autochthonous berry crops of Vojvodina. She joined the Department of Fruit Growing, Viticulture, Horticulture and Landscape Architecture as an assistant professor in 1994 and was promoted to full professor in 2007, retiring in 2019 as Professor Emeritus. Her research group focused on secondary metabolite accumulation—particularly anthocyanins, rutin, and chlorogenic acid—in elderberry (Sambucus nigra) accessions collected across the Pannonian Plain, with a sustained interest in how seasonal drought modifies these pathways. Teaching responsibilities included courses in small fruit production and plant biochemistry. Laboratory work relied on HPLC-DAD, spectrophotometric DPPH assays, and controlled drought chambers at the faculty's pomology laboratory.
record.industry_experience: Between 2005 and 2014, Professor Mamužić provided informal technical advice to two small elderberry processing cooperatives in Srem on raw material sourcing and drying protocols, though these engagements were not formalised as contracts. She has no other recorded industry partnerships.
record.notes: Professor Mamužić is fully retired and is not available for project leadership, supervision of doctoral students, or laboratory work. She is willing to consult on elderberry phytochemistry, Pannonian accession selection, and irrigation-based polyphenol enhancement strategies for companies working with elderberry raw materials or extracts. Contact is best arranged through the department, as she checks email infrequently. She retains access to the faculty's archived chromatographic data from the 1995–2016 period, which could be of value to companies seeking historical baseline datasets for the region.
